findings.body: Raise: Not done. The shipped guide says `forge stop` frees a native read's hold and that the coordinator must stop the subagent separately. Later, the same guide says a running run's verified process tree ends before its place is freed (line 188). Native stops deliberately leave the session and subagent running, so these instructions contradict each other on what `forge stop` does.
findings.title: Not done: stop guidance for native reads

findings.body: The new no-session refusal runs only through `repo.route`. The unchanged `worker.work` does not call it, so `forge work` can still start in a one-tool repo without a coordinating session. The separate WORK task owns that routing change.
findings.title: Later: route forge work through repo.route in WORK
